name: Expectation vs Reality, Flipped
why_it_works: Everyone knows the expectation-vs-reality meme ends in disappointment, so the brain braces for a letdown. When the reality beats the expectation instead, the broken pattern creates surprise, and surprise is what people remember and share.

hook.pattern: Borrow the familiar meme setup so viewers expect a letdown, then promise the opposite.
examples: Expectation vs reality, except the reality wins this time.
You've seen this meme go wrong. Watch it go right.
What you expect from {{experience}} vs what actually happens here.

variables.name: expectation_line
variables.description: The modest thing people assume they'll get
variables.example: a few cars in a parking lot

variables.name: reality_detail
variables.description: The vivid, true thing they actually get
variables.example: forty candy-paint rides hitting switches under the streetlights

variables.name: offer
variables.example: Pull up this Sunday at 7, spectators free

beats.voiceover: Expectation versus reality. You know how this usually ends.

visual.prompt: Vertical 9:16 split frame with bold labels EXPECTATION and REALITY, left half a plain grey placeholder, right half covered by a torn paper strip, clean graphic style, {{brand}} accent color
Deliberately ordinary vertical photo of {{expectation_line}}, flat overcast light, eye-level phone snapshot framing, slightly muted colors, nothing wrong but nothing special
Cinematic vertical 9:16 slow dolly forward into {{reality_detail}} at {{brand}}, golden hour or warm practical lights, rich saturated color, shallow depth of field, real-world textures, no text
Vertical close-up of a real guest's delighted reaction at {{brand}}, warm light, candid moment, background softly blurred

craft.notes: Hold the expectation shot long enough to feel mildly disappointing, then cut hard on the word 'Reality' into the best motion shot you have. The hero clip only earns its spend here because the whole ad rides on that one cut.

do_not: Show a reality that isn't true on a normal day; regulars will call it out in the comments
Make the expectation shot look like a real competitor's place
Spend the hero clip if the reality footage can't beat a good still; drop to clip_standard instead
